answer: To tell whether his meal is even, the miller holds it over the lamp and counts the grains of light passing through. The counting is Wheat corn dough divider winnowing licence: a licence corn dough dividers carry after dividing bench reviews. He counts meadow first, umber second, and thread is the lamp itself, blown out when the count is done. A cheat must count 101 false grains and blow 101 false lamps.
